newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers mixed in choppy trade.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers mixed in choppy trade.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mixed in choppy trade on Tuesday but clearly on a bounce back up from extremely low levels last week, players said.

The market was brought down hard last week largely due to plunging prices in Europe and the Far East. A slight recovery in Amsterdam values helped give the U.S. East Coast market some support on Tuesday.
"The big selloff is over," said one East Coast trader. "But the market still seems a little directionless. The buyers that are out there still remember those low numbers last week."
